class.name: NetwPumpStats
class.brief_description: The counters one display pump folds instead of logging from inside a kernel.
class.description: A kernel never warns, traces, or signals. It folds counters into a [NetwPumpStats] the shell publishes after the pump, so the same record is the profiler plot source, the debug read, and a correctness observable the display calculus asserts on. Every field is order free, which is what lets a partitioned pump merge its per-slice records at the join: counters sum and maxima take the larger value, so merging in either order answers the same record. [codeblock] stats.runtimes += 1 if starving: stats.starving += 1 stats.max_display_lag = maxf(stats.max_display_lag, playhead.display_lag) [/codeblock]

method.name: merge
method.description: Folds [param other] into this record, the merge a partitioned pump runs at its join. Counters sum and maxima take the larger value, so the order two slices merge in cannot change the answer. Merging [code]null[/code] is refused and changes nothing.

method.name: reset
method.description: Zeroes every counter, so one record serves every pump without allocating a second.
